item.title: 2x 2cm pavement slab tripping hazards, 15th August
item.description:
There are two uneven paving slabs which are sunken or raised meaning a three meter strip of pavement which is uneven and dangerous. There are four places where the difference in height are 2cm. It’s particularly dangerous for small children, scooters, buggies and wheelchairs. I have noticed it for at least 18 months, since my toddler has been mobile, as he has tripped multiple times on this spot. There are currently unfinished building works at the adjacent property (and dangerous hoardings) which makes it even more difficult to navigate around the uneven paving stones.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10, Anerley Park, Crystal Palace, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
